mechanics.claim: Enemy champions damaged by Jhin or allied champions, or that trigger a Lotus Trap, are marked as Caught Out for 4 seconds.
mechanics.quote: Enemy {{tip|champions}} that trigger a ''{{ai|Captive Audience|Jhin|Lotus Trap}}'' to bloom or are damaged by '''Jhin''' or allied champions are ''marked'' for 4 seconds.

mechanics.claim: Hitting a Caught Out marked champion roots them and grants Jhin bonus movement speed; this does not affect damage dealt.
mechanics.quote: Hitting a ''marked'' champion {{tip|root|roots}} them for a duration and grants '''Jhin''' {{ais|Whisper|Jhin|Every Moment Matters}} {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed|ms}}}}.

mechanics.claim: The shot deals physical damage to all enemies in a line until it hits an enemy champion, with reduced damage against minions.
mechanics.quote: fires a shot in the target direction that deals {{as|physical damage}} to all enemies in a line until colliding with an enemy champion, reduced by 25% against {{tip|minions}}.

mechanics.claim: Deadly Flourish applies spell damage to the champion hit and area damage to all other enemies hit.
mechanics.quote: Applies {{tip|spell damage}} to the enemy champion and {{tip|area damage}} to all other enemy units.
